subject: StridePay tenant ignition & API key seeding plan
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma@stridepay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: StridePay tenant ignition & API key seeding plan

Hi Emma —

Great to kick off. Congratulations on getting the MOA signed — welcome aboard. Attached is a compact onboarding checklist that outlines the minimal items we need to get your production tenant live and a suggested seed cadence for API keys and projects. Topline asks from our side so we can schedule the implementation sprint: 

1) Confirm three admin accounts we should invite (names + emails)
2) Preferred naming for the initial project namespaces (one production, one staging)
3) Do you want API keys bound to individual users or to service accounts (we recommend service accounts for CI/CD)
4) Any IP allowlist blocks or VPC peering requests we should plan for day 1

Suggested timeline:
- Day 0: invite admins + create projects
- Day 1: seed primary service account API key + run quick smoke tests
- Day 2: enable role scoping and add additional teammates

I copied Monica (implementation lead) and Karthik (solutions engineer) — they’ll run the seed and the key rotation handoff. I’ve attached the checklist: StridePay_Onboarding_MVP_Checklist.xlsx (compact).

Next steps: If you can reply with admin emails and project names I’ll schedule the 60-minute kickoff for TOMORROW (23rd) 3:00pm PT or Friday morning if that works better.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

- Admin invites: Emma Liu (emma@stridepay.com), Rajiv Menon (rajiv@stridepay.com), Priya Shah (priya.shah@stridepay.com)
- Initial namespace names: stridepay-prod, stridepay-staging
- We prefer service-account scoped keys for automation; assign per-project service accounts if possible
- No VPC peering day 0; we will add IP allowlist for our CI runners (range: 34.120.0.0/14)

Friday morning would be best for the kickoff (Aug 24) — 9:00am PT works for our engineering lead. I attached the signed MOA for your records. Please let me know if you need contact details for procurement.

Emma and team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for confirming details. Per your answers, here’s the implementation plan for Friday (Aug 24) 9:00am PT: 

Agenda (60 minutes):
- 0-10m: Intros + success criteria (Neha)
- 10-25m: Admin invites & project namespace creation (Monica) — we will create stridepay-prod and stridepay-staging and seed roles
- 25-40m: Service-account API key creation and secure handoff (Karthik) — we’ll create two svc accounts: redwood-svc-prod, redwood-svc-staging
- 40-55m: Smoke tests + token validation (Emma/Karthik)
- 55-60m: Next steps and rollback plan (all)

Operational notes / pre-reads (please review before the call):
- Seed script (we will run): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cStridePayOnboard (contains seed-script.sh and README)
- Recommended role mapping: Admin (full), DevOps (svc account managers), Engineers (read + generate); we’ll push an initial IAM scaffold and you can tighten scopes after Day 3
- IP allowlist: we will add the CIDR you provided to the staging project during the smoke tests and to prod after you sign off

I attached the quick seed script we’ll run during Friday’s call (seed-script.sh). Karthik — I’ll hand the session over to you after the project creation to run the key generation and demonstrate rotation.

If anything changes on your side, ping this thread. Otherwise we’ll see you at 9:00am PT.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai | +1 617-555-0133
